label: + on warfarin

edits.find: I’ve been feeling super anxious lately and I am 32.
edits.replace: I’ve been feeling super anxious lately and I am 32. I’m also on warfarin.

rationale: + on warfarin: first-line anxiety pharmacotherapy is usually an SSRI/SNRI, which raises bleeding risk and can potentiate warfarin (INR rise/GI bleed), so anticoagulation should prompt INR monitoring and cautious agent selection.
